description: This file contains the implementation of the ManufacturerDao interface, providing methods to access and manipulate manufacturer data in the database, including counting products associated with a manufacturer, listing manufacturers by store and categories, and retrieving manufacturer details by ID.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository implementation for manufacturer data access, extending generic DAO functionality and providing custom queries.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products associated with a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a manufacturer entity based on its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all manufacturers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers linked to products within given category IDs for a specific store and language.
